text:
marie-support: Heads up — escalated customer report. They see repeated 429s for model inference but Console quota panel shows ~60% available. Customer request_id: r-0a7f3b. Attached their sample curl and response. Can someone take?

raj-eng: on it. can you paste the raw response body + the x-request-id and enforcer trace id if present?

marie-support: response snippet: `{'error':'rate_limited','code':429}`. headers: `x-request-id: r-0a7f3b`, `x-enforcer-id: en-9c4`. Customer says this started ~30m after last Saturday release.

sam-telemetry: quick check on metrics — query shows a spike in enforcer->quota events failing to ingest around 2026-03-17T03:17:xxZ. Looks like the telemetry aggregator dropped ~2.1k events in that window (backfill pending). Could explain why Dashboard shows availability but enforcement was active.

laura-sre: which workflow writes the dashboard counters? is that the quota-summary-writer or the realtime-aggregator?

sam-telemetry: quota-summary-writer consumes the enforcer event stream, writes aggregated windows. The stream had a consumer lag because the aggregator process OOM'd during the weekend release; deploy-bot shows a restart at 03:16:12.

deploy-bot: build/redwood-inference@release-2026.03.16 deployed to prod at 03:14:50, rolling restart completed 03:16:10, service=telemetry-aggregator, instance=agg-12, status=restart.

raj-eng: if the enforcer still saw the requests but events didn't reach the summary writer, customers could get 429s while Console shows spare quota. Need to confirm enforcer logs show enforcement decisions for that request_id. laura, can you pull enforcer logs for en-9c4?

laura-sre: grabbing logs... found entry: `2026-03-17T03:17:05Z enforcer en-9c4 decision=reject reason=rate_limit limit=1000 window=60 used=1001`. So enforcement did reject.

marie-support: customer sent additional traces — they show repeated rejects with increasing token counts. They've escalated to legal if this persists. We need to reconcile and fix dashboard ASAP.

sam-telemetry: root cause: telemetry-aggregator process hit transient OOM GC due to a recent config bump (ingest.batch_size=500 -> 2000). That caused ~6m consumer lag; during lag the summary writer state didn't reflect enforcer's increments. Backfill of events is in progress but UI reads aggregate cache which wasn't updated until backfill completes.

raj-eng: mitigation options: 1) surface 'data freshness' warning on quota panels (short-term), 2) roll back ingest.batch_size change (hotfix), 3) backfill priority for enforcer events (medium-term). I can push a rollback if SRE agrees.

laura-sre: agree to rollback ingest.batch_size to 500. prepping change and will hotfix-deploy agg-12. ETA 10m.

mike-product: can we add a tooltip to the Console explaining possible telemetry lag and include last_event_time in the panel? This will reduce support escalations while we harden pipelines.

marie-support: customer notified: "we're investigating, temporary quota UI inconsistency possible due to telemetry lag. enforcement decisions are authoritative; we will reconcile and refund any erroneous 429s." customer asked for ETA: provided 2h.

laura-sre: hotfix rolled at 03:26:45, status: success. Consumer lag dropped to normal within 90s. Backfill job started and is ~35% complete.

sam-telemetry: verification: for request_id r-0a7f3b, backfilled event shows reject at 03:17:05 and summary writer now reflects the increment. Dashboard now shows correct usage; will monitor 30m.

raj-eng: created follow-up issue infra#4582 to: (a) add last_event_time to quota panels, (b) add alert on consumer lag >30s, (c) add per-release ingest config test.

marie-support: marking ticket as "monitoring" and will follow up with customer after 1h. Thanks team :heart:
